# How Big Is the AntiScam Dataset? A Detailed Assessment of Corpus Scale, Annotation Depth, and Conversational Dimensions

## Introduction

The AntiScam dataset is a corpus of human–human anti-scam dialogs introduced to support research on non-collaborative dialog systems — conversational settings in which the user and the system do not share a common goal (Li et al., 2019). The dataset was created to learn human elicitation strategies by placing participants in a role-playing Amazon customer service scam scenario, where one participant acts as an attacker attempting to extract personal information and the other acts as an everyday user defending that information (Li et al., 2019).
